Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm calling about the intercom in apartment 4b the handset still works but the door button has been cutting out since monday the building manager said the repair person would come thursday no sorry friday between one and three i can be home then um the lobby panel is the one by the mailboxes not the side entrance the technician asked whether the handset makes a clicking sound when i press the door button and i said right it clicks twice and then the buzzer stops the issue started after the power flickered on sunday night i checked with my neighbor in 4a and her button works normally please bring the small screwdriver if you need to open the panel and call me from the lobby instead of ringing the apartment because the bell is connected to the same faulty intercom i have two things to report the door release sometimes works and the audio is very quiet even when the volume is turned all the way up i haven't tried taking the cover off and i don't want to reset anything before the visit", "output": "I'm calling about the intercom in apartment 4B. The handset still works, but the door button has been cutting out since Monday. The building manager said the repair person would come Thursday—no, sorry, Friday—between one and three. I can be home then. The lobby panel is the one by the mailboxes, not the side entrance. The technician asked whether the handset makes a clicking sound when I press the door button, and I said, “Right.” It clicks twice, and then the buzzer stops. The issue started after the power flickered on Sunday night. I checked with my neighbor in 4A, and her button works normally. Please bring the small screwdriver if you need to open the panel, and call me from the lobby instead of ringing the apartment because the bell is connected to the same faulty intercom. I have two things to report: the door release sometimes works, and the audio is very quiet even when the volume is turned all the way up. I haven't tried taking the cover off, and I don't want to reset anything before the visit."}]
